entries.core_move: Identify the nonzero interval of $x(\tau)$ in the convolution variable so it becomes the fixed support constraint for determining overlap with $h(t-\tau)$.
Convert the support interval of $h(u)$ into the corresponding interval for $h(t-\tau)$ by holding $t$ fixed and reversing the inequalities in $\tau$.
Intersect the support of $x(\tau)$ with the support of $h(t-\tau)$ for a fixed $t$ to determine where the convolution integrand is nonzero.
Translate the overlap interval into the lower and upper $\tau$ limits for the continuous-time convolution integral.
Evaluate the convolution integral separately on each time region where the overlap bounds change, then assemble the piecewise output.
Identify values of $t$ where the supports of $x(\tau)$ and $h(t-\tau)$ do not overlap, and set the convolution output to zero on those regions.
Apply commutativity to swap the convolution factors when doing so makes the support analysis, overlap bounds, or piecewise evaluation simpler.
